description: IEEE_34_Node_Test_Feeder, published by liyifu93, implements the IEEE 34-node distribution test feeder in MATLAB and Simulink using parameters attributed to IEEE PES. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The repository cites a dissertation and topology-identification paper; its model files were not run. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance.
